program:
app "Workout week" dumbbell mint
table move name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning
table move_done move ref move
let n = count(move)
screen main "Today" check
  count(move_done today) "of" n "done today" head
  each move
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        it.part faint
      toggle it.move_done
  form move
screen stats "Stats" chart
  stat max(move, streak(it.move_done)), "best streak"
describe:
Workout week, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- move: name: text; part: one of Morning, Afternoon, Evening, starts at Morning. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- move done: move: a move. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many move entries.
Shows:
- a screen "Today":
  - text: how many move done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
  - for each move:
    - a group; a tap opens the move for editing; a swipe removes the move, with undo:
      - text: its name.
      - text: its part.
      - a tick box for its move done.
  - a form to add a move.
- a screen "Stats":
  - a big number: the highest of the current day streak of its move done entries over the move, labelled "best streak".
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

program:
app "Class quiz" school plum
table q question text, a text, b text, right pick A|B = A
state i num = 1
state score num = 0
if i > count(q)
  "Finished" head
  "Score" score "of" count(q) big
  button "Start again" tap set i = 1 then set score = 0
else
  "Question" i "of" count(q) faint
  let cq = nth(q sort at, i)
  cq.question big
  button cq.a tap set score = score + if(cq.right = A, 1, 0) then set i = i + 1
  button cq.b tap set score = score + if(cq.right = B, 1, 0) then set i = i + 1
form q, "Add question"
describe:
Class quiz, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- q: question: text; a: text; b: text; right: one of A, B, starts at A. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: i, starting at 1; score, starting at 0.
Shows:
- if i is more than how many q entries:
  - text: "Finished".
  - text: "Score", score, "of", how many q entries.
  - a button "Start again"; a tap sets i to 1, then sets score to 0.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Question", i, "of", how many q entries.
  - text: the question of the cq.
  - a button the a of the cq; a tap sets score to score plus 1 when the right of the cq is A, otherwise 0, then sets i to i plus 1.
  - a button the b of the cq; a tap sets score to score plus 1 when the right of the cq is B, otherwise 0, then sets i to i plus 1.
- a form to add a q.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the problem or reason

app "Car service" car ink

setting every_km num = 5000 "Service every (km)"

list service by day

- due km is the latest odometer of service plus every km.
- due date is the latest done on of service moved by every months months.

program:
app "Cards" cards slate
table point team pick Us|Them, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Us)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Them)
setting winat num = 100 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Us" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Us, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Us, pts = 10
  stack card grow align center
    "Them" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Them, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Them, pts = 10
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Us win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Them win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Cards, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Us, Them; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 100.

- text: "Them".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Them, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Them, pts set to 10.

  - text: "Us win!".

  - text: "Them win!".

program:
app "Meal plan" food mint
table meal day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun, slot pick Lunch|Dinner, dish text
table buy item text, got bool
screen plan "Plan" calendar
  each options meal.day as dd
    row gap 2
      dd bold
      stack grow
        each meal where day = dd sort slot as m
          row gap 1 tap edit m swipe remove m
            m.slot faint
            m.dish grow
  form meal, "Add dish"
screen shop "Shop" cart
  each buy sort got as b
    row card
      toggle b.got
      b.item grow
  form buy, "Add item"
describe:

        - text: the slot of the meal.
